title: Inside Darker’s flight model — evidence and illustration provenance
baseline: English 1995 retail; faithful engine, not Redux

manual.use: Fictional premise, craft and cockpit terminology; flight equations are recovered from code.

native_capture.description: Actual following-camera view of the selected mission after ordinary flight
native_capture.interventions: Debug mission entry (--level), native impact cheat (--cheat-life), reproducible keyboard input. No mission completion implied. No memory edits or invented events.

reused_tunnel_capture: images/graphics/tunnel.png; see data/graphics-figures.json for complete capture provenance

reproduction.requirements: Built faithful darker-cpp at the recorded revision, C++26 compiler. Python and matplotlib only to redraw SVGs. None are required to build or read the website.

numeric_columns.power_profiles: Samples every 1/32 map cell from centre (54.5,63.5) to (63.5,63.5), all lattice type-one beacons strength 255; each profile has its stated height.
numeric_columns.caero_steps: Two actual callbacks with frame_step=8, position (54.5,63.5), height=2400, level attitude, horizontal velocity and initial speed=600, vertical velocity=0, working buffer=16384, other stores zero, no boost, engine enabled. Normal, brake, altitude-hold-at-2400, and zero-strength lattice cases. Collision, input filtering and a rendered scene are not run.

limits: The beacon lab samples one source with exact fixed-width arithmetic; it is not a complete flight simulator.
Lift comparison freezes attitude and fixes pitch to zero; Skimma roll centring and evolving velocity are not simulated by that chart.
The controlled callback table is a short state comparison, not a terminal speed or a flight recording.
SVG route and aircraft silhouettes are explanatory schematics, not game geometry.

verification.existing_flight_energy_control_tests: 28282 assertions in 10 test cases passed on 2026-11-02

figures.source: Darker Discovered model gallery, bank=31, model=special-26; site base revision 43c3ed2
figures.capture: Chromium, 1000×1000 viewport, device scale1, default model orientation, one dollyOut(1.35) adjustment via the existing viewer control, title/buttons hidden. No retouching or resampling.
